response.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT ord.recordvault AS ordersmark, ord.timespan AS timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders ord ON e.ordersmark = ord.recordvault GROUP BY ord.orderspivot, ord.recordvault, ord.timespan), t AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS tif_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC) AS rnk FROM o) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - tif_avg AS above_tif_avg, rnk AS rank_in_timespan FROM t WHERE avg_fill > tif_avg AND rnk <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, rnk, ordersmark

assumptions.assumption: The time-in-force average fill is the mean of the per-order average fills within that timespan (each order counts once), ignoring orders whose fillcount is all NULL.
An order is identified by orders.recordvault (one group per order); executions are inner-joined so unmatched executions and orders without executions are excluded.

Ranks are computed over all orders in the timespan (RANK, highest avg first, NULLs last) before filtering to those above the timespan average and ranked 3 or better. Orders with NULL timespan form their own group.

alternatives.interpretation: The time-in-force average fill is the average of fillcount over all matched execution rows in that timespan (executions weighted equally rather than orders).
alternatives.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT ord.orderspivot, ord.recordvault AS ordersmark, ord.timespan AS timespan, e.fillcount FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders ord ON e.ordersmark = ord.recordvault), o AS (SELECT orderspivot, ordersmark, timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM j GROUP BY orderspivot, ordersmark, timespan), tf AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS tif_avg FROM j GROUP BY timespan), t AS (SELECT o.ordersmark, o.timespan, o.avg_fill, tf.tif_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.timespan ORDER BY o.avg_fill DESC) AS rnk FROM o JOIN tf ON tf.timespan IS o.timespan) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - tif_avg AS above_tif_avg, rnk AS rank_in_timespan FROM t WHERE avg_fill > tif_avg AND rnk <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, rnk, ordersmark
